hint: tap anywhere to stir up the wind

game.q: two minutes. your mind wandered ten times. you came back ten times. so?

wrong.fail: nope. the wandering isn’t the failure.

game.right: YES. every return is one rep. coming back is the practice.

end.line: arjuna said the mind is like the wind. krishna said: practice, and let go.
end.l1: the mind is like the wind.

cliff.s1: next: the wind blows out arjuna’s lamp at dinner.
cliff.s2: what he notices in the dark makes him great.

share: your mind isn’t broken. it’s untrained. training the restless mind, on infinite hill
